name: Flameskull

source.note: Numbers follow the 2014 Monster Manual flameskull; the 2024 block isn't entered yet. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Rejuvenation and Illumination are text only; spell slots are listed per spell.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.summary: Sheds light; it can switch between dim light and bright light with an action.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.summary: Destroyed, it re-forms after an hour with all its Hit Points, unless holy water, Dispel Magic or Remove Curse is used on its remains.

actions.name: Fire Ray
actions.summary: Shoots a ray of fire up to 30 ft.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Int, DC 13, +5: Mage Hand at will; Magic Missile, Shield, Blur, Flaming Sphere and one Fireball.
actions.text: A 5th-level spellcaster using Intelligence (spell save DC 13, +5 to hit). Cantrip: Mage Hand. 1st level (3 slots): Magic Missile, Shield. 2nd level (2 slots): Blur, Flaming Sphere. 3rd level (1 slot): Fireball.

summary: A flying, burning skull: twin fire rays, Magic Missile and a Fireball, and it re-forms unless its remains are blessed.
